reasons: Both structured candidates increase >500 mm error counts on development. Joint window also worsens aggregate mean and adds computation. No promotion or retuning on heldout.

joint_estimation.scientific_gap: Decoded single-peak/inlier observations cannot recover discarded image hypotheses; shared lengths and acceleration did not remove gross front-end errors.

selection.reason: Advance fixed X head to known heldout assessment: development common mean/P95 67.059/132.697 -> 65.105/128.742 mm, all-target success 0.735583 -> 0.738167, >500mm outputs 31 -> 23. S2 mean and all-target success slightly worsen; head cost about doubles. No parameter changes.
selection.final_reason: Development improvement did not transfer to frozen known heldout: aggregate mean, P95 and all-target success worsened; body-head processing cost about doubled.

kinematic_observability.scope: Derived landmark/hinge reference, differentiated reference velocity. No anatomical rotation or force labels, foot availability is not accuracy; unknown remains unknown.

post_scoring_changes: Model checksum enforcement and JSON manifest normalization; persisted already-used calibration std floors; file replay source deadline accounting, bounded no-state memory, and validated 4/4 worker configuration. No offline pose algorithm parameter tuning.
limitations: No physical exposure-to-output latency or actual G1 validation. Online timing includes file I/O and scheduled host time; slowed 10 Hz replay is not full-speed human motion capture.
No independent anatomical rotation, contact force, full foot orientation or physical foot-slip truth. Default ground is unknown; support remains unknown.
Joint local covariance propagation ignores unknown cross-correlations and systematic detector/calibration/joint-definition bias. Empirical intervals give no hardware safety permission.
Reference-block calibration uses 20 dependent one-second blocks. High coverage obtained with broad radii is not useful fine-control accuracy.
Online input-stall repair bounds backlog but did not yield any timely outputs under injected 40ms/group delay; deadlines still reject every new motion in that stress case.
Controller untouched; previous full imitation 0/10 remains historical evidence, not a rerun or an improvement in this round. No SOTA or best-possible claim.
next_priority: Preserve multimodal pixel evidence and jointly test cross-view identity/occlusion hypotheses; separate detector/joint-definition bias from body scale; acquire independent rotation/contact and physical clock references.
